nodes.description: Address of the contract creator / train driver; receives 20% of every seat payment.
Public counter of passengers; used as modulo divisor and as randomness seed.
Index of the selected winning passenger seat.
Pseudo-random seed derived from a past blockhash plus the passenger count.
Accumulated jackpot 1 (0.1 ether tier).
Accumulated jackpot 2 (1 ether tier).
Accumulated jackpot 3 (10 ether tier).
Remainder value used to decide whether a jackpot must be paid.
Fixed seat price of 0.1 ether required from every passenger.
Distribution amount, 20% of the seat price.
Array of Passenger structs storing each passenger address and gain.
Constructor that sets traindriver to msg.sender.
Payable fallback handling seat purchase, driver/passenger payouts and the three jackpots.
Caller-controlled address used both as passenger record and as contract creator.
traindriver.transfer(percent) external Ether transfer to the driver.
passengers[winseat].passengeraddress.transfer(percent) external Ether transfer.
External transfer of jackpot1 to a pseudo-randomly selected passenger followed by reset.
External transfer of jackpot2 to a pseudo-randomly selected passenger followed by reset.
External transfer of jackpot3 to a pseudo-randomly selected passenger followed by reset.
Unchecked increment numbofpassengers++ on Solidity 0.4.x arithmetic.
randomhash = uint256(blockhash(block.number-1)) + numbofpassengers, weak randomness plus unchecked addition.
winseat = randomhash % numbofpassengers, weak randomness with modulo (division by zero when count is zero).
modulo = numbofpassengers % 5, gate used to trigger jackpot 1.
modulo = numbofpassengers % 50, gate used to trigger jackpot 2.
modulo = numbofpassengers % 500, gate used to trigger jackpot 3.
jackpot1 += percent unchecked addition.
jackpot2 += percent unchecked addition.
jackpot3 += percent unchecked addition.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns msg.sender as traindriver, giving the caller the driver role and its payout stream.
msg.sender is written into the passengers array as passengeraddress.
Any external caller sending exactly the seat price enters the payable fallback.
percent is derived from seatprice (seatprice / 10 * 2).
The driver transfer amount is percent.
External Ether transfer to the driver address (state-changing call target).
The winning passenger is paid percent.
winseat indexes the passenger entry that receives the payout.
External transfer to an address read from the passengers array, executed before jackpot state is finalised.
jackpot1 is sent to an external address before the jackpot state variable is reset to zero.
jackpot2 is sent to an external address before the jackpot state variable is reset to zero.
jackpot3 is sent to an external address before the jackpot state variable is reset to zero.
numbofpassengers is the operand of the unchecked ++ increment.
Increment writes back into numbofpassengers without overflow checking.
jackpot1 is increased by percent.
Unchecked += writes jackpot1.
jackpot2 is increased by percent.
Unchecked += writes jackpot2.
jackpot3 is increased by percent.
Unchecked += writes jackpot3.
numbofpassengers is added to the blockhash-derived value in an unchecked addition.
randomhash receives the weak-randomness, unchecked arithmetic result.
randomhash is the dividend of the seat-selection modulo.
numbofpassengers is the modulo divisor; zero value causes a division-by-zero revert.
The computed seat index is stored in winseat.
numbofpassengers % 5 determines the jackpot 1 gate.
numbofpassengers % 50 determines the jackpot 2 gate.
numbofpassengers % 500 determines the jackpot 3 gate.
The jackpot 1 gate result is stored in modulo.
The jackpot 2 gate result overwrites modulo.
The jackpot 3 gate result overwrites modulo.
The fallback always executes the driver payout.
The fallback always executes the winning-passenger payout.
The fallback conditionally reaches the jackpot 1 payment block.
The fallback conditionally reaches the jackpot 2 payment block.
The fallback conditionally reaches the jackpot 3 payment block.
If modulo == 0 after numbofpassengers % 5, jackpot 1 is paid.
If modulo == 0 after numbofpassengers % 50, jackpot 2 is paid.
If modulo == 0 after numbofpassengers % 500, jackpot 3 is paid.
The constructor grants the traindriver privilege to whoever deploys / calls first.
